notes: Mars 4K is sold as a matched TX+RX kit (1 transmitter + 1 receiver), each a separate physical box, so "physical I/O" spans two enclosures — ports above are tagged (TX) or (RX) accordingly; if this catalog models TX and RX as distinct devices, split this entry using the existing convention seen elsewhere in the catalog (e.g. "Mars 4K TX" / "Mars 4K RX"). Each unit also has an RP-SMA antenna connector (x1-2, for the 5GHz wireless link) which is omitted from ports since no RF/antenna connector id exists in the allowed connector list. Each unit has a 1/4"-20 tripod mounting hole (mechanical, not a signal/power port, omitted). HDMI is confirmed 1.4b and SDI confirmed 3G-SDI directly on the manufacturer spec page; other web sources (B&H, Amazon, Filmtools) corroborate 3G-SDI/HDMI and general capability but could not be fetched directly (403/parse errors) for independent cross-check, hence confidence is medium rather than high. Desktop/handheld form factor (115x65x32mm, 223g), not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted.
